name: Waveshare ESP32-S3 Touch LCD 3.5 Family

touch.notes: Touch may be used for page navigation experiments, not final approve/reject signing consent.

display.notes: The 3.5 inch 320x480 display is the reason this board family is preferred as the secondary ESP32 QR vault target for local Nostr event review.

camera.notes: Only case-plus-OV5640 variants are accepted for this target. Historical SeedSigner MicroPython prior art references a 3.5B display path.

approval_inputs.name: approve
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware approval model after exact SKU validation; touch-only approval remains disallowed.

approval_inputs.name: reject
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a different physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware rejection model after exact SKU validation.

wireless_policy: Wireless must be disabled or excluded in high-assurance QR vault builds; no Wi-Fi or BLE path may participate in signing approval.
debug_policy: Debug access stays enabled for board bring-up and must be locked before any production-key experiment.
production_signing: disabled until exact case-plus-OV5640 SKU, camera, display, physical controls, storage, provisioning, and signing tests pass
reference_notes: Preferred secondary ESP32 stateless QR vault target after LILYGO T-Display S3 Pro.
Do not treat historical seedsigner-micropython comments as current official SeedSigner support.
Exact display/touch drivers must be split into a concrete board profile once 3.5-C versus 3.5B-C hardware is selected.
